item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 07/Nov/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will affect Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be generally fine over the region, and slightly cooler in the morning and at night. Tropical Cyclone Yinxing will move across Luzon Strait and enter the South China Sea today and tomorrow. It will then move westwards across the northern part of the South China Sea over the weekend. However, under the influence of the northeast monsoon, there are uncertainties in Yinxing's movement and intensity after entering the South China Sea. Under the combined effect of the monsoon and Yinxing, it will be windy and cloudier over the waters and high ground of the coast of southern China over the weekend.
